meta.title: Hominin Lineage Timeline — One Solid Column Genetic Migration Estimations
meta.description: Comprehensive coverage of face, body, bones, IK/poses, shapes from early hominins (fossil refs: Smithsonian 3D, Australian Museum casts, Bone Clones) through archaic to anatomically modern Homo sapiens. Unified 'solid_column' per stage for iterative genetic migration lineage estimations. Designed for character bibles in Grok Imagine prompts, consistency across generations, and holo ID badge card prototyping (Spline/Three.js/Mixamo rigs). Source data synthesized from public collections + genetic studies (admixture estimates ~1-6% archaic in modern populations depending on path).
sources: Smithsonian Human Origins, Australian Museum, genetic papers (Out-of-Africa ~55-60kya main wave + earlier pulses; Neanderthal ~1-2% non-Africans; Denisovan up to 6% Oceanians)
Mixamo auto-rigs + animation library for IK/poses
meta.usage: Iterate by 'stage_index' or filter by 'era'. Use 'unified_migration_lineage' as the single solid column for lineage tracing/estimation in scripts or prompts. 'prompt_traits' + 'bible_snippet' for direct insertion into ancestry madlibs. 'fossil_refs' for 'reference the [Bone Clones cast of X / Smithsonian 3D scan of Y]' in prompts for accuracy. 'mixamo_threejs' for 3D rig/pose/animation guidance when building refs or holo cards.
meta.holo_badge_notes: For holo ID cards: each stage produces a 'card' with 3D-ish portrait (gen via imagine using bible + 'holographic floating ID badge, iridescent, sci-fi, spline style'), timeline position, genetic % estimates, migration path. See holo_id_badges/ prototype.

stages.name: Sahelanthropus tchadensis
fossil_refs: Australian Museum / general early hominin casts for comparison
Bone Clones early hominin category (base for reconstructions)
stages.unified_migration_lineage: African origin (Chad basin, ~7mya); pre-bipedal or facultative; last common ancestor candidate with chimpanzee lineage. No major migration; localized woodland/forest edge populations. Solid column base: 'Africa (Central) | 7mya LCA split | 0% sapiens-admixture (pre-split) | arboreal + some terrestrial foraging'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Small brain ~350-380cc; thick supraorbital torus (brow ridge); reduced prognathism vs apes but still projecting face; foramen magnum position suggests some upright posture capability; small canines, thick enamel teeth for tough diet.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Limited postcrania; inferred from context: short stature, some bipedal capability but retained arboreal traits (curved phalanges likely). Intermembral index high (ape-like arm length).
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Base: quadrupedal/knuckle-walking ape-like with emerging bipedal elements. Mixamo: start with primate rig or 'chimpanzee-like idle', apply forward-leaning 'facultative biped' pose, short strides. Three.js: additive blend base locomotion + 'foraging reach' upper body. Shapes: robust cranium morph, heavy brow ridge blendshape.
stages.shapes_morphs: Heavy supraorbital torus, low vault, projecting midface, small braincase relative to face. Body: stocky, short limbs relative to some later forms.
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: N/A (pre-Homo split); represents deep LCA. Later sapiens carry no direct but foundational for all hominin lines.
stages.prompt_traits: Sahelanthropus-like early hominin features: small braincase, prominent continuous brow ridge, reduced but present prognathism, thick cranial bones, small canines visible in open-mouth expressions, woodland forager build with some bipedal posture potential, high intermembral index, dark dense fur coverage with vellus underlayer.
stages.bible_snippet: of deep early hominin (Sahelanthropus tchadensis ~7mya) ancestry expressing as small ~360cc braincase, thick continuous supraorbital torus, moderately projecting face with thick enamel dentition, stocky short-statured build with retained arboreal adaptations and emerging bipedalism (foramen magnum hints), heavy brow ridge contribution to face shape (robust square-leaning with heavy frontal), dark skin/fur with high eumelanin for forest/edge UV protection.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo: Upload base mesh, auto-rig as 'primate' or human base then tweak spine/hip for slight upright; use 'idle' or 'walk' animations slowed, blend with 'reach' or 'forage'. Three.js skinning: base skeleton + additive 'torso lean forward' clip + arm foraging morph. For holo badge: static 'Toumai reconstruction' portrait with heavy brow emphasis, floating in iridescent card frame.
stages.migration_notes: Localized; possible early experiments in terrestrial locomotion in Central African woodlands before major savanna expansions.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: heavy continuous brow ridge dominating forehead, low flat cranial vault, robust jaw with large molars, short powerful neck, forward-shifted center of gravity for occasional bipedal stance, dark matte skin with subsurface depth under dappled light.

stages.name: Ardipithecus ramidus
fossil_refs: Smithsonian 3D hominin fossils (Ardi scans if available)
Bone Clones early hominin / Australopithecus precursors
stages.unified_migration_lineage: African (Afar region, Ethiopia); woodland biped + arboreal mosaic. Solid column: 'East Africa (Afar) | 4.4mya | facultative biped in forests | 0% later admixture (foundational) | mosaic locomotion'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Small brain ~300-350cc; less robust brow than Sahel; reduced canine dimorphism (less ape-like); thinner enamel; face less projecting.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Famous for: grasping big toe (arboreal), but pelvis and foot bones show bipedal capability on ground. Arm/leg proportions more balanced than apes but not fully human. 'Ardi' skeleton key for transitional pose.
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: Human base rig with modified foot (grasping toe hint via morph or separate), hip for bipedal but bent-knee 'Ardi walk'. Poses: 'upright on branch' to 'ground biped shuffle'. Three.js: additive blending of 'arboreal suspension' upper + 'bipedal stance' lower body clips.
stages.shapes_morphs: Smaller brow, more orthognathic face than earlier, chimp-like but with biped hints in pelvis. Body: small stature ~1.2m, long arms relative, opposable big toe for climbing.
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: Deep ancestral; informs early bipedalism genetics. No direct % in modern but foundational for all later African lines.
stages.prompt_traits: Ardipithecus ramidus transitional hominin: small brain, reduced brow ridge vs Sahel, smaller less dimorphic canines, woodland mosaic locomotion (bipedal on ground with grasping feet for trees), long arms, short legs relative, small body size, dark skin, fine body hair.
stages.bible_snippet: with Ardipithecus ramidus (~4.4 mya) deep ancestry expressing in transitional features: modest supraorbital development, less projecting face than earlier forms, reduced canine size, pelvis hints of bipedalism combined with arboreal foot adaptations (grasping big toe potential), long arms short legs (high intermembral), small ~1.2m stature, mosaic forager build.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo auto-rig human child/small adult base; use 'climb'/'hang' animations + 'walk' variants with knee bend and toe spread morph. Three.js: skinning with additive 'branch sway' + 'ground stride' for holo viz. Badge: Ardi reconstruction portrait, half arboreal/half biped pose floating.
stages.migration_notes: East African Rift valley woodlands; local adaptations before savanna expansion and later dispersals.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: small cranium with gentle brow, flatter face profile, powerful but short legs for bipedal waddle, long powerful arms for climbing/foraging, flexible foot with divergent toe, fine dark vellus hair over body with terminal patches.

stages.name: Australopithecus afarensis (Lucy)
key_fossils: many others; 'Mrs Ples' A. africanus related South Africa
fossil_refs: Australian Museum: 'Lucy' Australopithecus afarensis skull cast, Mrs Ples, Taung Child
Bone Clones: Australopithecus afarensis / africanus skulls and postcranial sets
Smithsonian 3D if scans available for Lucy/Dikika child
stages.unified_migration_lineage: East/South Africa; savanna/woodland bipedal specialists. Solid column: 'East Africa (Afar/Hadar) + South | 3.2mya | obligate biped with arboreal remnant | foundational for Homo line | 0% archaic sapiens admixture'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Brain ~400-500cc; moderate brow ridge; prognathic face; small braincase relative to face; parabolic dental arcade starting; foramen magnum central for full bipedalism.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Lucy: short ~1.1m female, valgus knee (knock-kneed for biped stability), short legs long arms (intermembral ~85), curved phalanges (some tree use), pelvis human-like for biped but small birth canal. Classic 'bent-hip bent-knee' or efficient striding debated but clearly bipedal.
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: small adult female rig; 'A-pose' base then 'Lucy walk' animation (short stride, slight waddle or efficient). IK for arms in 'forage low' or 'carry infant' (famous Dikika). Three.js additive: biped locomotion base + 'arm swing for balance' or 'climb remnant' upper body. Shapes: prognathic lower face blend, small cranium on top of robust neck/shoulders.
stages.shapes_morphs: Prognathic midface, moderate brow, small rounded cranium, wide pelvis for biped but flaring, short powerful legs, long arms, small hands/feet relative. Steatopygous potential in some reconstructions for fat storage.
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: Key ancestor or close to LCA for Homo + Paranthropus branches. Modern humans carry no direct archaic % from this level but the bipedal adaptations are universal.
stages.prompt_traits: Australopithecus afarensis (Lucy ~3.2 mya) ancestry: small 1.1m stature, short legs long arms (intermembral index high), valgus knee bipedal gait with some arboreal capability (curved fingers/toes), prognathic face, moderate brow ridge, small brain ~450cc, wide flaring pelvis, dark skin, body hair gradient (more terminal on limbs).
stages.bible_snippet: predominantly recent sapiens with deep Australopithecus afarensis (~3.2mya Lucy lineage) foundational ancestry expressing as small stature potential, long arms relative to legs (high intermembral), valgus knee bipedal posture with efficient striding capability, moderately prognathic face with moderate supraorbital development, small cranium on robust neck, wide pelvis, curved phalanges hint in hands, steatopygous gluteal adaptation possible for fat storage in variable environments.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo: auto-rig petite female or child scale; library 'walk' slowed + 'carry' or 'forage' animations; IK foot placement for biped stability. Three.js: base skinning walk + additive 'arm balance swing' + facial prognathism morph target. Holo badge: Lucy reconstruction (famous face) in striding pose, 3D floating with timeline marker at 3.2mya, 'first strong biped' label.
stages.migration_notes: Rift Valley focused; later related forms (A. africanus South Africa) show range. Precedes first Homo and major tool/culture expansions.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: prognathic lower face with small teeth visible, gentle brow, short powerful build, arms that hang past knees slightly, bipedal stance with knees slightly bent or locked, dark rich skin with subsurface scatter showing muscle definition under film grain.

stages.name: Paranthropus boisei / robust australopiths
fossil_refs: Australian Museum: Paranthropus boisei skull casts (multiple), robustus
Bone Clones Paranthropus / robust australopith skulls and sets
stages.unified_migration_lineage: East/South Africa; 'robust' side branch, not direct sapiens ancestor but contemporaneous. Solid column: 'East/South Africa | 2-1.2mya | specialized megadont herbivore biped | sister to Homo line | 0% direct in sapiens'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Brain ~500-550cc; massive sagittal crest for jaw muscles; enormous molars/premolars (megadontia), dish-shaped face, heavy brow, flaring zygomatics. 'Nutcracker' for hard/tough vegetation.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Bipedal like afarensis but more robust build, powerful jaws/neck for chewing. Postcrania less specialized for arboreal than earlier.
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: robust mesomorph male rig; 'power stance' or 'heavy forage/chew' poses. IK for massive mandible action. Three.js: additive 'jaw clench/chew' morph + biped locomotion (heavier, shorter stride). Shapes: extreme robust face with dish + crest, barrel chest, thick bones.
stages.shapes_morphs: Hyper-robust face: sagittal crest, huge cheekbones, massive jaw, small front teeth large back teeth, heavy neck musculature. Body: stocky, barrel chest, thick limb bones.
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: Extinct side branch; no known admixture into sapiens (unlike Neanderthals). Represents parallel robust evolution.
stages.prompt_traits: Paranthropus boisei robust hominin 'cousin' branch ~1.8mya: massive 'nutcracker' face with sagittal crest, enormous molars, dish-shaped face, heavy brow and zygomatics, powerful neck and jaw muscles, robust stocky bipedal body ~1.3-1.4m, barrel chest, thick bones, dark skin, heavy terminal body hair for display or protection.
stages.bible_snippet: with Paranthropus boisei (~1.8mya) robust side-branch ancestry (not direct line but contemporaneous expression possible in admixture models) manifesting as hyper-robust 'nutcracker' craniofacial features: prominent sagittal crest, flaring zygomatic arches, massive post-canine dentition, dish-shaped face, very heavy brow ridge and nuchal musculature, stocky powerful build with barrel chest and thick limb bones for powerful bipedal foraging of tough vegetation.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo: heavy mesomorph rig; 'power pose' base, 'chew' or 'dig root' animations with heavy IK on jaw/spine. Three.js skinning: locomotion + strong additive 'crest/jaw power flex' and torso thickness morphs. Badge: Zinjanthropus face reconstruction, hyper-robust, in powerful stance holo card.
stages.migration_notes: African only; specialized niche alongside early Homo tool users. Died out as environments changed.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: enormous flaring cheekbones and sagittal crest, tiny front teeth huge grinding molars visible, heavy neck, powerful short stocky frame, bipedal but with ape-like shoulder power for digging/processing.

stages.name: Homo habilis / early Homo
fossil_refs: Australian Museum: Homo habilis 1813 skull cast, others
Bone Clones early Homo / habilis skulls
stages.unified_migration_lineage: East Africa; first 'Homo' with stone tools (Oldowan). Solid column: 'East Africa Rift | ~2mya | tool-making biped, larger brain | bridge to erectus | pre-migration core'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Brain ~500-800cc (larger than australopiths); less prognathic than Lucy, higher forehead in some, still robust brow in others; smaller teeth than Paranthropus but larger than later Homo.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: More human-like proportions than australopiths but still some primitive traits. Bipedal with better endurance potential. Hand bones for precision grip (tool use).
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: early human rig; 'tool use' animations (Oldowan chop/flake), 'scavenge/walk' . IK for dexterous hands. Three.js: additive 'precision grip hold' + biped walk, face less prognathic morph. Shapes: higher vault, reduced face projection.
stages.shapes_morphs: Larger braincase relative, reduced (but present) brow, less projecting face, human-like hand for tools. Body: taller than Lucy ~1.3m+, more gracile in some.
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: Direct ancestor line to erectus/sapiens. No archaic % yet.
stages.prompt_traits: Homo habilis early Homo ~2mya: brain ~650cc, higher forehead than australopiths, reduced prognathism, smaller teeth, dexterous hands for Oldowan tools, bipedal with improved endurance, still some long arm traits, ~1.3m stature, dark skin, emerging less hairy body.
stages.bible_snippet: Homo habilis early tool-making Homo ancestry (~2-1.6mya) expressing as larger braincase (~600-700cc) with higher vault and reduced brow compared to australopiths, less prognathic face, precision-grip capable hands, improved bipedal proportions for ranging, smaller body size ~1.3m with some retained arboreal upper body strength, first cultural (Oldowan) expression in face of curiosity and problem-solving.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo: human base small adult; 'manipulate object' / 'chopper' animations + walk. Three.js additive blending for hand tool use + locomotion + subtle facial 'focus' expression. Badge: habilis reconstruction with tool in hand, early Homo 'clever forager' holo ID.
stages.migration_notes: Still Africa-centric; sets stage for erectus expansions.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: higher rounded cranium, softer brow, flatter face profile, clever expressive eyes, nimble hands shown in tool grip or gesture, lean bipedal build with purposeful stride.

stages.name: Homo erectus / ergaster (Turkana Boy)
fossil_refs: Australian Museum: 'Turkana Boy' Homo ergaster skull, multiple Homo erectus skulls (Sangiran 17, Solo man, etc.)
Bone Clones: Homo erectus / ergaster skulls, skeletons, postcranial (full sets available)
Smithsonian 3D: hominin fossils including erectus/ergaster scans
stages.unified_migration_lineage: Africa (ergaster) -> first major Out of Africa ~1.8mya (Dmanisi Georgia, then Asia to Indonesia/China). Multiple waves. Solid column: 'East Africa -> Eurasia (Levant/Georgia/Asia) | 1.8mya first exodus | long persistence in Asia | core ancestor to heidelbergensis | 0% Neanderthal yet (pre-split)'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Brain ~850-1100cc; low vault, thick bones, prominent supraorbital torus (double arched in some), receding forehead, projecting face but less than habilis, shovel-shaped incisors in Asian forms, nuchal torus.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Turkana Boy: ~1.6m tall at death (adolescent), modern body proportions (long legs, short arms — low intermembral), narrow pelvis, barrel chest? Efficient striding biped, endurance runner/hunter potential. First 'human-like' skeleton.
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: full modern human teen/adult rig (Turkana proportions); 'striding walk', 'spear throw' or 'hunt' animations, 'upright posture' emphasis. IK full body for long stride. Three.js: excellent for skinning — base erectus locomotion + additive 'tool carry' or 'fire use' gestures, facial torus morph. Shapes: low vault + torus face, athletic long-legged build.
stages.shapes_morphs: Low long cranium with heavy brow torus, receding forehead, robust but human-proportioned body, long legs short arms, narrow hips, thick cranial vault.
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: Ancestor to later archaic (heidelbergensis -> Neanderthal/Denisovan + sapiens lines). No direct % but the erectus-grade body plan is baseline for all later Homo.
stages.prompt_traits: Homo erectus / ergaster (Turkana Boy ~1.6mya) ancestry: brain ~900-1000cc, low vaulted cranium with heavy continuous or double-arched supraorbital torus, receding forehead, robust projecting but reduced face, shovel incisors possible, barrel or robust chest, long legs short arms (modern proportions), narrow pelvis, ~1.6-1.8m adult stature, dark skin, minimal body hair, endurance bipedal hunter-gatherer build.
stages.bible_snippet: Homo erectus/ergaster deep ancestry (~1.6mya Turkana Boy + Dmanisi/Sangiran lines) expressing as low-vaulted cranium with prominent heavy supraorbital torus/brow ridge, receding forehead, robust but less prognathic face than earlier Homo, modern body proportions (long legs, short arms, narrow pelvis for efficient striding bipedalism), barrel chest, thick bones, ~1.7m stature, first true long-distance endurance capabilities, dark equatorial skin with high irradiance refraction capacity.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo: standard human rig (scale to 1.65m); huge library — 'walk', 'run', 'throw', 'dig', 'climb' all fit erectus range; auto-rig any base mesh to get IK controls for posing. Three.js skinning additive blending perfect: e.g. 'striding biped' base animation + 'spear thrust' or 'fire maintenance' upper body additive clip + facial 'heavy brow focus' morph. For holo badge: Turkana Boy reconstruction (adolescent), striding with tool, 3D model on card with '1.8mya first global migrant' + migration path viz.
stages.migration_notes: First hominin to leave Africa in significant numbers ~1.8-1.5mya. Reached Georgia (Dmanisi), Indonesia (Sangiran ~1.6mya+), China, possibly Europe. Long persistence (until ~100kya in Java 'Solo'). Multiple dispersals.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: heavy brow shelf dominating face, low long head shape, powerful neck and shoulders for carrying, long striding legs, upright posture with slight forward lean for endurance, dark skin showing rich subsurface in raking light, tool in hand with precision grip.

stages.name: Homo heidelbergensis / antecessor (common archaic)
key_fossils: Boxgrove (UK), Sima de los Huesos (Spain, early Neanderthal-ish), Kabwe/Broken Hill (Zambia), Bodo (Ethiopia), Arago (France), Petralona (Greece)
fossil_refs: Australian Museum: 'Kabwe' or Broken Hill 1 Homo heidelbergensis, Swanscombe, Steinheim, Arago
Bone Clones archaic / heidelbergensis skulls
stages.unified_migration_lineage: Africa (heidelbergensis) + Europe/Asia branches. Split point: African line -> sapiens; Eurasian -> Neanderthal + Denisovan. Solid column: 'Africa + Eurasia | 600-400kya | large-brained archaic | last common ancestor sapiens/Neanderthal/Denisovan | pre-admixture for sapiens line'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Brain ~1100-1400cc (large); robust brow (double arched), receding forehead, projecting face, thick vault, large nasal aperture, no chin. Kabwe has very large face/brow.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Robust, tall (some 1.8m+), strong build, similar to Neanderthal in some but more sapiens-like in others. Good biped with power.
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: robust adult male rig; 'heavy labor' or 'hunt large game' poses/animations, full IK. Three.js: additive power movements + facial robust torus. Shapes: big face + large braincase blend.
stages.shapes_morphs: Large cranium with heavy brow, big face, robust neck/shoulders, powerful but upright body.
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: LCA for sapiens + Neanderthals/Denisovans ~550-750kya per DNA. Sima de los Huesos ~430kya early Neanderthal DNA.
stages.prompt_traits: Homo heidelbergensis archaic large-brained hominin ~600kya: brain 1200+cc, heavy double-arched brow ridge, receding forehead, large projecting face and nose, thick cranial bones, robust tall powerful build ~1.7-1.8m, dark to medium skin depending on latitude, strong endurance + power hunter build.
stages.bible_snippet: Homo heidelbergensis (~600-400kya) common archaic ancestry (LCA to sapiens and Neanderthals/Denisovans) expressing as large braincase (1200cc+), prominent heavy double-arched supraorbital torus, receding forehead, large robust face with projecting midface and broad nose, thick vault, powerful robust tall build with strong neck and shoulders, modern bipedal proportions but thicker bones and muscle mass potential.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo: tall robust male rig; 'spear hunt', 'butcher', 'fire' animations with IK for powerful grips. Three.js additive: base striding + heavy 'club/spear' arm swings + 'brow focus' face. Badge: Kabwe or Bodo reconstruction, large face, powerful archaic human on holo card with split lineage note.
stages.migration_notes: Widespread in Africa + Europe + possibly Asia. First controlled fire evidence, advanced tools (Acheulean handaxes). Leads to regional archaic populations.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: massive continuous or arched brow ridge over deep set eyes, large face dominating cranium, heavy jaw without chin, thick neck, broad powerful shoulders, long legs for ranging, skin tone variable but rich subsurface scatter.

stages.name: Homo neanderthalensis (Neanderthals)
key_fossils: Neanderthal 1 (Germany), La Ferrassie, La Chapelle, Amud 1 (Israel), Le Moustier, Gibraltar, many European + Near East
fossil_refs: Australian Museum: multiple Homo neanderthalensis skulls (Amud 1, Le Moustier, Gibraltar, youth, 1, Galilee partial)
Bone Clones: extensive Neanderthal skulls, skeletons, postcranial (full sets, reconstructions by Sawyer/Maley)
Smithsonian 3D hominin (Neanderthal scans)
stages.unified_migration_lineage: Eurasia (Europe + West Asia) from heidelbergensis branch. No Africa origin for classic forms. Solid column: 'Eurasia (Europe/ Levant) | 400kya split from sapiens line | cold-adapted | 1-2% introgression into non-African sapiens ~50-60kya | extinct ~40kya'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Brain ~1200-1750cc (large, long low vault); massive double-arched brow, receding forehead, large midface, big nose (cold adaptation?), no chin or weak, 'bun' occipital, large orbits, midfacial prognathism.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Stocky, barrel chest, short limbs (cold adaptation, Allen's rule), thick bones, powerful, short stature ~1.6-1.7m males. Bipedal with wide gait or powerful. Large hands/feet.
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: stocky mesomorph/ endomorph male rig (short limbs); 'power crouch', 'spear thrust close range', 'scavenge' animations. IK for stocky proportions. Three.js: additive 'barrel chest breathing' + 'heavy tool' + facial 'occipital bun' and 'big nose' morphs. Shapes: cold-adapted stocky powerful.
stages.shapes_morphs: Long low cranium, huge brow, midface projection, big nose, occipital bun, short thick limbs, barrel chest, no waist definition, powerful.
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: 1-2% (up to ~4% in some) Neanderthal DNA in all non-African modern humans from ~50-60kya admixture events (multiple pulses). Higher in some Europeans/Asians; affects skin, immune, metabolism, brain. Some back-migration to Africa low %.
stages.prompt_traits: Homo neanderthalensis Neanderthal ancestry (1-2% typical in non-Africans) expressing as long low cranium with massive double-arched brow ridge and occipital bun, receding forehead, large mid-projecting face with broad prominent nose (cold adapted), weak chin, robust stocky build with short limbs relative to torso (Allen rule), barrel chest, thick bones, powerful neck/shoulders, ~1.65m stature, pale to medium skin with high capability for low-UV latitudes but retaining subsurface depth, possible red hair variants in some, heavy terminal body hair in cold climates.
stages.bible_snippet: with 1.8% Neanderthal archaic admixture (from ~50kya Eurasian contact) expressing as long low-vaulted cranium with prominent double-arched supraorbital torus and occipital bun, receding forehead, large robust midface with broad nose and midfacial prognathism, weak or absent chin, stocky cold-adapted body with barrel chest, short distal limbs, thick bones, powerful build, pale-medium skin with excellent multiple scattering subsurface and tiger-stripe potential under side light, robust hair patterns.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo: stocky short-limbed male rig (custom scale); library has 'Neanderthal-like' power animations or use 'brute' / 'heavy' + 'squat'. IK for powerful close combat or butchery poses. Three.js skinning: base 'wide power stance' + additive 'spear close' or 'scrape hide' + strong facial 'brow + bun + nose' morph targets. Excellent for holo: classic Neanderthal reconstruction (heavy brow, bun, nose), stocky powerful, in fur or minimal, floating holo ID with '1-2% in you' genetic note + migration 'Eurasian contact ~55kya'.
stages.migration_notes: Evolved in Europe from heidelbergensis ~400kya; ranged to Siberia, Middle East. Coexisted with incoming sapiens ~60-40kya. Extinct or absorbed ~40kya. Admixture key event for modern non-Africans.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: massive brow shelf and bun giving 'heavy' head silhouette, large fleshy nose, midface forward, no chin, barrel torso on short powerful legs, pale skin with rich internal glow and visible vascular/melanin micro patterns, thick neck, hands large and strong.

stages.name: Denisovans
stages.era: Middle-Upper Pleistocene ~200-50 kya (known from DNA + few fossils)
key_fossils: Denisova Cave finger bone, teeth, mandible (Siberia/Altai); some in Tibet (Baishiya); possible in other Asia
fossil_refs: Limited physical; Bone Clones / Australian may have 'archaic Asian' or heidelbergensis proxies; use genetic + limited cranial for reconstruction
stages.unified_migration_lineage: Central/East Asia + high altitude (Tibet) from heidelbergensis branch, parallel to Neanderthals. Solid column: 'Asia (Altai + high plateau) | ~400kya split | high-altitude/UV adaptations | 2-6% in Oceanians/Papuans/Melanesians + trace in Asians | extinct'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Limited: large teeth (molars), robust mandible. Inferred large brain, robust like Neanderthal or heidelbergensis but Asian variants. Possible distinct facial features (less known than Neanderthal).
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Very little; inferred robust, perhaps cold/high altitude adaptations (Tibet Denisovan EPAS1 gene for hypoxia).
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: robust Asian-like or general archaic rig; high altitude 'endurance in thin air' poses. Three.js additive for 'hypoxia adapted breathing' + robust face. Use Neanderthal-like base with Asian cranial variations.
stages.shapes_morphs: Robust jaw/teeth, inferred large cranium, possible flatter face or distinct nasal for altitude. Body: robust with possible high-altitude efficiency.
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: 2-6% in Papuans, Aboriginal Australians, some Oceanians/Philippine Negritos; ~0.1-1.6% in mainland Asians. Also small % in some S. Americans via ancient. Key genes: EPAS1 (high altitude), immune, skin pigmentation variants.
stages.prompt_traits: Denisovan archaic ancestry (2-6% in Oceanians, trace East Asians) expressing as robust Asian archaic features: large molars and robust mandible, possible high cheekbones or flatter midface variants, adaptations for high UV or altitude (altered vascularity, melanin patterning), robust build with efficient metabolism in thin air or variable climates, dark to medium skin with unique subsurface and tiger stripe potential from Denisovan melanin genes.
stages.bible_snippet: with 3.2% Denisovan archaic admixture (high in Oceanian/Papuan lines from ~50-40kya Asian contact) expressing as robust jaw and large post-canine dentition, possible high-altitude/UV adapted skin vascularity and dispersed melanin clusters producing unique tiger-stripe subsurface scattering, robust but efficient build for endurance in varied Asian/highland environments, trace in facial width or nasal form, dark skin with excellent multiple internal refraction for rich color depth.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo: robust build with Asian cranial base; 'high endurance' or 'mountain' animations if available, or generic power + 'thin air breathing' emphasis. Three.js: skinning with additive high-altitude posture/breathing + facial robust jaw + unique skin micro-pattern morph. Holo badge: artistic Denisovan reconstruction (based on DNA + limited fossils), highland or Siberian setting, genetic % callout, 'EPAS1 hypoxia hero' note.
stages.migration_notes: Asia-focused (Siberia to SE Asia/Tibet). Interbred with sapiens during/after OOA. Contributed key adaptations still in living people (esp. island SE Asia/Oceania).
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: robust lower face with big teeth, possible broad or high cheeks, skin with distinctive micro-patterning or vascular glow, efficient powerful yet lean build, dark rich skin showing complex internal light play.

stages.name: Early Homo sapiens (Africa + early exits)
key_fossils: Jebel Irhoud (Morocco ~315kya), Omo Kibish (Ethiopia ~233kya), Herto (Ethiopia), Skhul/Qafzeh (Israel ~90-120kya early exit), Misliya (Israel ~180kya)
fossil_refs: Australian Museum: various early Homo sapiens (Skhul 5, Liujiang, Minatogawa, Zhoukoudian Upper Cave, Cro-Magnon)
Bone Clones: anatomically modern / early sapiens skulls
stages.unified_migration_lineage: Africa origin ~300kya (Jebel Irhoud). Early exits to Levant ~180-90kya (failed or limited). Main OOA ~60-50kya. Solid column: 'Africa (Morocco/Ethiopia) | 300kya emergence | early pulses to Levant/Asia | main global ~55kya + archaic admixture | all living humans descend from this + admixture'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Brain ~1350cc+ modern range; high rounded vault, vertical forehead, reduced or absent brow ridge (gracile), flat face, prominent chin, small teeth, large braincase relative to face.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Fully modern proportions: long legs, narrow pelvis, high crural index in tropical lines, gracile to robust depending on population. Efficient striding, endurance, throwing capability.
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: full modern human rigs (any ethnicity base); entire animation library applicable. IK standard for all modern poses. Three.js: full skinning + morph targets for face (high forehead, chin, reduced torus) + body (gracile vs robust). Additive any combination (walk + talk + gesture).
stages.shapes_morphs: High vaulted cranium, vertical forehead, orthognathic (flat) face, chin, small brow, modern body (long legs, narrow shoulders/hips ratio variable by sex/population).
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: Base ~100% recent African sapiens + variable archaic (Neanderthal 0% pure African to 2%+ others; Denisovan as above). Multiple founder effects in migrations.
stages.prompt_traits: Early anatomically modern Homo sapiens ~200kya African origin with later admixture: high rounded forehead, vertical frontal, reduced brow ridge or none, flat orthognathic face with prominent chin, small teeth, large braincase, fully modern body proportions (long legs relative to torso in many equatorial lines, high crural index), gracile to robust build by population/lifestyle, skin melanin calibrated to latitude (high eumelanin equatorial for UV protection with dense packing + tiger stripes; lower in high latitude with dispersion for vitamin D).
stages.bible_snippet: primarily recent Homo sapiens sapiens (~300kya African origin, Jebel Irhoud/Herto lineage) with {X}% archaic admixture (Neanderthal/Denisovan as appropriate to migration path) expressing as high vaulted cranium with vertical forehead and minimal brow, flat face with chin, small gracile dentition, fully modern body proportions (long legs, balanced intermembral index, narrow pelvis for efficient striding bipedalism and birth), {skin science details calibrated to ancestry and latitude}.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Mixamo: any modern human character upload -> perfect auto-rig + 1000s animations (idle, walk, run, dance, fight, emote — all usable for 'early sapiens' or modern). Three.js: the example additive blending is ideal for complex layered animation (base locomotion + facial expression + object interaction + secondary motion). For holo badge: any modern or early sapiens reconstruction (high forehead, chin, gracile), fully rigged if possible, timeline at '300kya Africa' or '55kya OOA', genetic pie chart (sapiens base + % archaic), migration path line, 'your direct ancestors' framing.
stages.migration_notes: Africa cradle. Early failed/ limited exits ~180kya+. Main successful ~60kya wave populates Eurasia (with admixture), then Australia ~50kya, Americas ~15-20kya+. All living humans primarily from these African source populations + regional archaic input.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: high clear forehead, vertical profile, prominent chin, flat midface, expressive eyes with less heavy brow, long-legged graceful or athletic stride, skin tone and subsurface exactly matching ancestry latitude (rich deep with tiger stripes equatorial; fair with high glow high latitude).

stages.name: Anatomically Modern + Regional Populations (Upper Paleolithic to Holocene)
key_fossils: Cro-Magnon (France), many global (Liujiang China, Minatogawa Japan, Wadi Halfa, etc.) + all living variation
fossil_refs: Australian Museum: Cro-Magnon, Liujiang, Minatogawa, Zhoukoudian sapiens, many regional modern skulls
Bone Clones: full range of modern human skulls (anatomically modern category)
stages.unified_migration_lineage: Global after main OOA. Regional differentiation + later admixtures/back migrations. Solid column: 'Global post-55kya | multiple waves + founder effects + archaic input | all living humans | ongoing micro-evolution + culture'.
stages.cranial_face_bones: Full modern range: high vault, vertical forehead, orthognathic face, chin, variable brow (none to slight), variable nasal, dental arcade parabolic. Population specific: e.g. shovel incisors East Asia, etc.
stages.body_postcranial_pose: Full modern variation: tall Nilotic (high crural, ectomorphic), stocky cold-adapted (short limbs), steatopygous Khoisan, etc. All obligate efficient bipeds with throwing, endurance, fine manipulation.
stages.ik_pose_shapes: Mixamo: the gold standard — thousands of rigged characters and animations covering every modern pose, cultural dance, sport, labor, expression. Full IK/FK. Three.js: additive blending for infinite combinations (e.g. walk + wave + talk + facial micro-expressions). Perfect end of the line from fossil base.
stages.shapes_morphs: Full spectrum face shapes (oval to triangle as in current traits.json) + body somatotypes + hominin variants overlaid. Population-specific cranial metrics (e.g. higher vault in some, broader face in others).
stages.genetic_admixture_estimates: Varies: Sub-Saharan African ~0% Neanderthal/Denisovan (or trace ancient); Europeans ~1-2% Neanderthal; East Asians ~1-2% N + small D; Oceanians/Papuans 1-2% N + 2-6% D; Native Americans variable archaic + later. Recent admixture (e.g. African-European-American) creates new combinations. All humans ~99.9% genetically similar with structure from migrations.
stages.prompt_traits: Anatomically modern Homo sapiens of {specific population/ancestry mix e.g. 70% West African + 20% European + 10% East Asian recent admixture + deep 1.5% Neanderthal + 0.5% Denisovan} with fully modern high forehead, vertical profile, orthognathic chin face, variable face shape per ancestry (see face_shapes), body proportions per lineage (ectomorphic Nilotic high crural, mesomorphic Eurasian, steatopygous + steatopygia Khoisan-related, robust cold short-limb), skin calibrated precisely to mix (e.g. medium-deep with warm undertones and 32% subsurface + faint tiger stripes from equatorial base + Denisovan vascular).
stages.bible_snippet: fully anatomically modern Homo sapiens of {detailed admixture from traits + this timeline e.g. primarily recent East African sapiens with 1.8% Neanderthal + 0.4% Denisovan + recent Eurasian/African blend} expressing the complete modern package: high vaulted forehead vertical and gracile, reduced brow to none, flat face with chin, small teeth, modern body proportions varying by specific lineage (long legs high crural index for heat dissipation or stocky cold adapted short limbs), full range of face shapes and hair textures per the ancestry_traits, skin science exactly as calibrated in traits with admixture-specific melanin dispersion and tiger striping.
stages.mixamo_threejs: Ultimate: Mixamo for any body type/pose/IK (upload your generated character mesh for perfect rig, or use library). Three.js for runtime blending, morphs (face shapes, body fat/muscle), additive layers (multiple animations at once for complex 'psychological' performance). For holo ID badges: the end state — modern person (or blended ancestor portrait) in futuristic holo card, with scrubber through the full 10 stages (fossil face morphing to modern via blendshapes), genetic migration path animated as 'solid column' line or tree, % pie updating, 'generate consistent character at this stage' button that outputs the exact bible snippet + prompt for imagine.
stages.migration_notes: Peopling complete: Australia 50kya+, Europe 45kya+, Americas 20kya+ (or earlier). Holocene: agriculture, cities, globalization create new admixtures. Future: ongoing but cultural/technological dominant over genetic for 'evolution'.
stages.visible_in_prompt_examples: high clear forehead and vertical profile, prominent chin, expressive flat face, body exactly matching the lineage (e.g. tall lean with long legs or powerful stocky or curvaceous with steatopygia), skin/hair/eyes/sub surface precisely ancestry-calibrated for maximum realism under any lighting or LUT.

iteration_guidance.how_to_iterate: Use stage_index 0-10 sequentially or filter by era/migration_path for 'genetic migration lineage estimations'. The 'unified_migration_lineage' is the single solid column — parse it in scripts for path, date, admixture, key events. For a character at specific point: pick stage, fill bible_snippet into madlibs, add 'reference [specific fossil cast from Bone Clones / 3D.si.edu scan]' + 'Mixamo rig pose: [ik_pose_shapes suggestion]' for 3D consistency if building refs.
iteration_guidance.solid_column_example_usage: In Python/JS: for stage in data.stages: print(stage['stage_index'], stage['unified_migration_lineage'].split('|')[0]) to step through. Estimate admixtures by accumulating from OOA onward.
iteration_guidance.hominin_to_modern_bridge: Stages 0-4: fossil dominant (use casts for ref accuracy in prompts). Stage 5-6: transitional. 7-8: archaic with % in modern. 9-10: modern base + variable archaic overlay + regional. Always specify % and visible expression for Grok Imagine precision.
